text.text_excerpt: I had the pleasure of being in the wedding party for my brother's wedding, which was held at this venue this weekend. I have heard stories of the owners being difficult to get in touch with, even from my brother's new wife. However, I am just reviewing the actual space itself since I had no contact with the owners anyway. The wedding was beautiful, and this space is the most magical old style New Orleans venue. There are two houses and a slave quarter, so we were all able to get ready in one of the houses without having to worry about a hotel or a limo.There are interesting things in every direction, antiques, posters and statues everywhere. The courtyard is covered in beautiful flowers a...

This is one of my favorite locations in the city! The decor is lovely and has a "retro, 50's, old New Orleans feel". This would be the ultimate place to hold a wedding and/or reception because it has that Southern charm that you want in a New Orleans wedding. The house has three different floors and a separate quarters, so that guests can stay on the premises. It has all the amenities of home and the courtyard is lovely with a nice pool. I was fortunate enough to be photographed for New Orleans Weddings Magazine in this house and you can't ask for better ambiance for an "old fashioned" type of wedding or party.

In my opinion this is the #1 place in NOLA for weddings!! This place is just unique. No other city has the architecture that NOLA has and Race & Religious fits right in with the city. It was built in the 1800's and is the perfect place to wow your guests at your special event. Guests from other states come here and are amazed. They all comment how they have never been to a wedding venue like this. I don't even have to write anymore. Just look at the pictures. The pictures don't lie....Race & Religious is a beautiful and unique place! BOOK YOUR WEDDING HERE!!!
